title: M3 Arrays - Relative Sort Array
description:
Given two arrays arr1 and arr2, sort arr1 so that elements appear in the order defined by arr2. Elements not in arr2 go at the end in ascending order. Preserve the number of occurrences of each value.

Assume arr2 contains distinct integers.

Input: Two lines of space-separated integers. The first is arr1; the second is arr2. An empty array is represented by a blank line.
Output: The sorted elements of arr1, separated by spaces.

Example 1
arr1 = [2, 3, 1, 3, 2, 4, 6, 7, 9, 2, 19]
arr2 = [2, 1, 4, 3, 9, 6]
Output: [2, 2, 2, 1, 4, 3, 3, 9, 6, 7, 19]
Elements from arr2 appear first in that order. Remaining elements 7 and 19 follow in ascending order.

Example 2
arr1 = [28, 6, 22, 8, 44, 17]
arr2 = [22, 28, 8, 6]
Output: [22, 28, 8, 6, 17, 44]

Example 3
arr1 = [5, 5, 5, 5]
arr2 = [5]
Output: [5, 5, 5, 5]
